newsitem.title: GREECE: National Bank/Greece to cut depo, loan rates Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: National Bank/Greece to cut depo, loan rates Dec 2.

text.p: The National Bank of Greece will cut its savings and time deposit rates by 50 basis points and lending rates by 25 basis points, effective December 2, a high-level bank source told Reuters.
The base savings rate will be reduced to 10.75 percent from 11.25 percent, he said.
The National Bank of Greece is the country's largest commercial bank. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
